falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the pattern has failed and lower lows are likely, contradicting a bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom formed with VIX peaking near 28; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation beyond the reference pattern, suggesting this is not a comparable bottom but rather a breakdown into deeper crisis, invalidating the structural similarity

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 5,100
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals a growth scare/fear bid into bonds with equity weakness, unlike August 2024 when yields fell with stabilizing equities; it would indicate the current environment is a recessionary de-risking rather than a rate-relief bottom, breaking the pattern's causal logic

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
